tei:div.tei:p: 185)༄༅/ sgom rim gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba/ sgrub khang chen mor nyams bzhes mdzad tshul sngon byon rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes la zur du smos ma dgos kyang*/ ma ṇi kho na dung phyur gcig lo gsum cher sgrub pa'i dbang du btang na/ thor thun dung bus pa dang*/ gti mug gnyid dkrog bzlas brjod nus pa stobs byin/ rnam 'joms/ dme brtsegs tsam grub nas/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig= sogs kyis/ yig bdun kho na gsog rnga rdung dus/ dkon spyi tsam 'don/ de ma thag ma ṇi 'don/ chu gtor gnam chos kho na tsam 'don/ me thun grol dus/ 'ur gsum rdung*/ maṇḍal so bdun/ 'ur gsum rdung*/ de bar ma ṇi kho na 'don/ bsang rnga dus/ bla ma pad 'byung/ tsam ma ṇi 'don/ bhruṃ yig= dus rnga phyogs brdung dgos/ yi dam ḍā dril dus yang 'dus btaun nas/ ma ṇi kho na thun bcad/ dzar thun grol dus 'ur bdun rdung*/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal bdun rdung*/ sa gzhi spos chus 'ur bdun rdung*/ gung tshigs bar ma ṇi kho na/ phyi thun sdom dus stong pa'i ngang sogs tsam gyis ma ṇi 'don/ phyi thun grol dus 'ur dgu rdung*/ hrīḥ bla ma yi dam= dgu rdung*/ sa gzhi spos chus= 'ur gsum rdung*/ bar bar ma ṇi kho na 'don/ rtsa gsum las byang nang*/ stong pa'i ngang las= sbyar ba rnga brdung*/ ma ṇi kho na gsog bdud rtsi kun khyab rnga rdung dgos/ bsam pa'i don kun yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ sum rdung*/ ja dung tshe ma ṇi 186)kho na 'don/ bzhes 'bod tshab zab mdo bdud zlog bya/ yam bskang man rnga brdung*/ de nas ma ṇi kho na 'don/ gcod thun grol dus gnam chos lus sbyin tsam/ ḍā dril byed/ ma ṇi kho na btaun nas/ gzim rnga rgyab tsam nas bzang spyod sogs kyi bsngo smon bcas byas nas nyal lo// de'i tshe sgom don ni/ dal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa'i lus rten 'di rnyed par dka' zhing*/ rnyed na don che ba la snying po len snyam pa dang*/

lus rten 'di'ang skad cig gis mi rtag 'chi ba'i dbang du gyur pas/ 'chi khar phan pa'i chos rnam par dag pa 'grub dgos pas de'i ched du sgrub snyam pa dang*/ shi nas spyir 'khor ba dang*/ sgos ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal gyi 'jigs pa las rang gzhan sems can thams cad thar ba'i phyir dang*/ rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pas rang gzhan thams cad kyi sngon bsags kyi sdig sgrib thams cad sbyong ba'i phyir dang*/ khyad par skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po la bdag gzhan sems can thams cad mthor gtong dmar gtong khyed mkhyen snyam pas yid khyedashes kyi dad pas skyabs su 'gro bar bgyi'o snyam pa dang*/ tshe 'di'i mi mthun phyogs zhi phyir 'jigs skyob dang*/ mthun rkyen sgrub phyir legs smon dang*/ 'di phyi gang la gtad so med pa'i lung ma bstan dang*/ phyi ma ngan song las thar te mtho ris sgrub pa dang rang don du 'khor ba las bral te myang 187)'das la dmigs pa rnams theg chen lam du mi 'gyur bas/ rtsa ba'i pha mas thog drangs khams gsum sems can thams cad mar shais/ drin dran/ drin lan gsab 'dod/ sdug bsngal bral 'dod/ bde ba ldan 'dod/ rang 'dod ma 'dres pa'i lhag pa'i bsam pa zur dang po snying rjes sems can la dmigs/ zur phyi ma shes rab kyis rdzogs byang la dmigs pa'i don gnyis dang 'brel ba'i 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la dmigs pa'i smon pa dang*/ de'i phyin drug gi bsdus pa'i dge rtsa la dmigs pa'i 'jug sems ldan pas sras bcas rgyal ba'i rnam thar la slob pas sems bskyed cing*/ de'i bslab bya bdag gzhan mnyam pa dang*/ brje ba dang*/ bdag pas gzhan gces kyi bsam sbyaur dang ldan pas lus longs spyod dge rtsa dang bcas pa lan dang rnam smin la mi re ba'i gzhan don du sbyin pa/ nyes spyod kyi cha dang bcas pa ldog pa'i tshul khrims/

gzhan la khong mi 'khrugs pa'i bzod pa/ chos phyir spro ba'i brtson 'grus/ sems rtse gcig pa'i bsam gtan/ thos bsam bsgom pa'i shes rab zab mo la bar med du gzhol ba dang*/ bla ma thugs rje chen po spyi bor bsgom zhing skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya ba rten gyi stobs dang*/ sngar byas kyis sdig pa la 'gyod pa rnam par sun 'byin dang*/ phyin chad rang gi spang blang nus tshad bsgrub pa'i dam bca' rnam par sor chud pa'i stobs dang*/ 188) ma ṇi bzlas shing gsol ba btab pas 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs gyi sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung bas lus kyi phyi dang*/ khyad par lus kyi nang thams cad bkrus te sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu/ sol khu/ nad rnams rnag khrag gdon rnams srog chags kyi rnam pa 'og tu song bas/ 'chi bdag gis gtsos pa'i lan chags byang ba dang*/ slar bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis 'khor lo bzhi gang bas sdig sgrib dag dbang bzhi thob/ dga' bzhi'i ye shes rgyud la skyes pa dang/ bla ma 'od du zhu ba rang la thim pas rang lus thugs rje chen por gyur pa'i thugs srog dang sngags phreng las 'od zer spros pa rgyal ba sras bcas mchod cing byin rlabs bsdus pa dang*/ sems can la phog brten dang rten pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams su gyur par mos la sgrib sbyong tshul du bzla ba dang*/ rang gi rnam shes khros mar gyur pa nam mkhar spar te/ lus che ba tsho ba stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i kā pa la phyes pa thod sgyed gsum steng bzhag pa'i nang du lus tshogs 'khor du bshams pa/ 'og gi a thung las me 'bar/ thod pa dros/ bdud rtsi khol/ steng gi haṃ 189)yig zhu bas ro brgya nus pa stong dang ldan par gyur pa/ sri zhu/ yon tan/ snying rje'i/ lan chags kyi mgron bzhis tshim par rol bar bsam pa dang*/ sa phyogs rnam par dag pa ri bo po tā la dang*/ zhing khams khyad par 'phags pa'i dbus su/ gzhi lus rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la/

mdun mkhar bla ma spyan ras gzigs dbang bzhugs pa dbyings nas rgyal ba sras bcas spyan drangs te thim pa la yan lag bdun pa 'bul zhing*/ rtse gcig tu gsol ba btab pas/ sku yi gnas bzhi nas 'od zer byung ba rang gi gnas bzhir thim/ sgrib bzhi dag dbang bzhi thob/ rig 'dzin bzhi dang*/ sku bzhi 'grub pa'i snod rung du byas te/ mthar 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas thugs yid dbyer med du 'dres par bsam pa yan gyi sngon 'gro'i dmigs rnams dang*/ ༈ dngos bzhi bum dbang lam bskyed rim la chos thams cad 'ja' tshon nam mkha' la yal ba ltar gyur par bsam la stong nyid la cung zad gzhag 'gro la snying rje'i shugs dang lhan cig stong nyid kyi rtsal las rten 'byung 'gag med du shar ba'i rgyu yi sa bon hrīḥyig la sems bzung zhing*/ de las 'od zer gyis steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje bsrung ba'i gur khang chen por gtams pa'i nang du nam mkha' rlung chu sa'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ri rab bang rim bzhi pa'i khar/ 190) rdo ra me ris bskor ba'i nang du pad rwa dang*/ rgya gram gyi lte bar thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan chas thams cad ma tshang ba med pa'i dbus su padma zla ba'i steng du rgyu'i sa bon babs pa las padma hriḥs mtshan pa/ de yongs su 'gyur pa las 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po rgyan dang cha lugs thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ spyan gyi dkar nag tshun chad ma 'dres par rnam par gsal ba/ chos dbyings spros bral 'od gsal ye shes kyi rang mdangs chos can rtags kyi lha skur shar ba rnam dag dran pa/ 'bras bu mngon gyur gyi sangs rgyas dngos yin pa'i nga rgyal brtan pa ste bskyed pa sku yi gzer/ thugs srog mar me ltar 'bar ba'i mtha' bskor sngags kyis mgal me'i phreng ba ltar bskor ba las/ bying ba'i tshe 'od zer sna bug g.yon nas byung ba lte ba nas tshur thim pa dang*/

rgod pa'i tshe 'od zer lte ba nas byung ba sna bug g.yas nas tshur zhugs pa'i do li'i bzlas pa bar ma chad pa dang*/ 'khor 'das la 'od zer spro bsdus/ bdag don dngos grub bsdu zhing*/ gzhan don sgrib pa sbyong ba snga ma lta bus snod bcud ye shes kyi 'khor lor gyur pas bung ba tshang zhig ltar 'ur ti ri ri bzla bar bsam pa bzlas pa sngags kyi gzer dang 'phro 'du phrin las kyi gzer yin/ thams cad du rig stong rjen pa'i ye shes zang ma thal byung skyong ba dgongs pa mi 'gyur ba'i gzer/ thun mtha' 191)rnams su dag pa'i snod bcud gzhal yas khang la/ de lha la/ de sngags 'khor la/ de thugs srog la/ de rim gyis 'dus te thig le til 'bru tsam du gyur pa/ de nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar mi dmigs par gyur par bsam la mnyam par bzhag skad cig gis thugs rje chen por gyur pa/ snang ba lha/ sgra grags sngags/ dran rtog ye shes kyi rol par lam du khyer bas skye 'chi bar do gsum gyi dri ma dag sku gsum gyi yon tan gzhi la rdzogs pa'i nges shes bskyed/ gsang dbang gi lam rlung gi rdzogs rim ni/ phyi lus kyi stong ra rang lus thugs rje chen por gsal ba dang*/ nang rtsa'i stong ra rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi gsal ba'i dbus su/ gsang ba sems kyi stong ra snying dbus ye shes sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs/ thugs kar 'od lnga'i klong du thugs srog bcas gsal btab/ rlung ro phyir bus pas tshe rabs kyi sdig sgrib dang sgom skyon bying rmugs 'thib gsum rlung nag po'i rnam par phyir song bar bsam pa dang*/ slar 'khor 'das kyi dwangs bcud thams cad nam mkha'i rlung mthing ga'i rnam par sna bug nas lcags kyu bzhin bzung nas rngubs pas ro rkyang gi lam brgyud de/ snying dbus kyi ye shes sems dpa'i thugs srog la thim par bsam pa dang*/ 'og rlung gyen du 'then/ steng rlung lte 'og tu mnan pa bum pa bzhin bskyil ba dang pho ba rked g.yas su gsum/

192) g.yon du gsum bskor nas/ dmigs pa thugs srog la gtad/ rgya mdud bzhin gzhil ba mthar sna bug nas dal bus btang dus thugs srog la thim par bsam pa dang*/ thig le'i rdzogs rim ni/ rtsa dbu ma'i nang spyi bo nas snying ga'i bar brgyud pa'i bla ma tho brtsegs su bzhugs pa la gsol ba gdab/ mthar 'od du zhu bas spyi bor haṃ yig dang lte 'og a shad gsal gdab la/ rlung sngar bzhin bzung bas/ lte 'og gi me sbar lte ba nas spyi bo'i bar rim par sleb/ haṃ yig las 'khor 'das dwangs bcud 'dus pa'i thig le babs te 'khor lo bzhi gang bas dga' bzhi'i ye shes skye bar bsam la rlung bzung bas bde drod 'bar ba dang*/ sher dbang gi lam gyi dod thub rang nyid spyan ras gzigs la yum gsang ba ye shes kyi 'khril ba'i mkha' gsang rdo rje dang padma/ thabs 'dis bde chen gyi ye shes bskyed par bsam pas gsang 'khor dang*/ mar sna'i rtse mo phaṭaḥkyis bkag par bsam la thig le rim par zhu bas/ lte ba nas yar drangs pa dang*/ de goms pas gsang gnas kyi rtsa ba nas yar drangs pas bde chen mi 'gyur ba'i 'pho med lhan skyes kyi zhu bdes drangs par bsam pa dang*/ dbang bzhi pa'i lam khyer ka dag khregs chod la 'khor 'das kyi rtsa ba sems rnam rtog 'di/ dang po byung sa byung mkhan/ bar du gnas sa/ tha mar 'gro 193)sa/ gzugs dbyibs kha dog ngo bo ngos bzung rnams ji ltar 'dug dpyad pas gzhi med nam mkha' lta bu yin par shes pa dang*/ sems kyi yal sa la brten nas yul snang ma 'gags rig cha yod la 'gyu cha med pa/ dngul chu sa la lhung ba lta bu yul dang 'dres mi shes pa/ gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa dang bral ba/ gsal la ngo bo med pa/ yangs pa phyal bar ma shor/ rtag chad kyi mtshan ma ma grub/ yin min rtsis gdab bral ba/ stong pa la had por ma song ba/ dmigs gtad kyi mtshan mar med pa/ bar med kyi rig pa har sangs/ rig ge

rjen ne/ sal le/ seng nge yod kyang sems kyi dmigs pa'i yul dang bral ba/ rnam rtog thams cad bltas pa tsam gyi rang yal/ rang sangs/ rang 'gags/ rjes med du 'gro ba/ 'di yin gyi ngos bzung med pa/ 'di min gyi sgyur du med pa/ rgya gar yang ma chad/ phyogs gang du yang ma lhung*/ sgom du med/ bsam du med/ dmigs su med/ 'dzin du med/ med bzhin du rjen sang nge/ dwangs sal le/ yangs seng nge/ bzo med du lhug ge 'dzin med du khrigs se/ sgo lnga ltar yul la mi g.yeng*/ yid shes ltar gzung bar mi rtog nyon yid ltar 'dzin sems med pa/ kun gzhi ltar 'thib por ma song*/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes ltar gnas char ma shor/ tshogs brgyad ltar khyab cing*/ 194) tshogs brgyad las 'das pa/ rig pa rang gnas kyi ye shes chen por nyin mtshan bar med du yengs su spu tsam yang med la/ sgom du rdul tsam yang med par bar med chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la dmigs gtad mtshan 'dzin re dwogs bral bas skyong bas nyin mtshan 'od gsal 'khor yug tu 'dris pa 'byung ngo// zhes pa'ang shar rgyal mo rong pa karma 'jam dbyangs bzang po dpal yul sgrub khang chen mor zhugs pa'i tshe nyer mkho dran gsos su padma ma ṇis bris pa dge legs 'phel// bkra shis//
